title: Critique draft requirements for a support assistant
summary: Spot the defects in five draft requirements.
scenario: A draft requirements list for a customer-support assistant has landed on your desk. Each requirement may have zero or more defects. Constructed for teaching.

requirements.text: The assistant shall be fast and user friendly.
The assistant shall use a vector database and the largest available language model.
For at least 95% of requests, the first token shall appear within 3 seconds, measured at the 95th percentile over a week.
The assistant shall answer every customer question.
All answers shall cite a source document; if no source supports an answer the assistant shall say it cannot answer and offer a human handoff.
